sources.evidence: Stellantis' April 7 2026 official release states that the FIAT Tafraoui factory in Algeria is operating, produced 53,000 vehicles in 2025, has operational stamping and paint lines, assembly operations, and targets 90,000 vehicles in 2026.

Stellantis' official production-start release identifies the Tafraoui plant's initial vehicle range beginning with the FIAT 500 and FIAT Doblò and its CKD processes including painting, welding and stamping.

Stellantis' December 18 2025 official release identifies the FIAT Grande Panda as the first passenger vehicle produced in CKD format in Algeria and states that Tafraoui had launched production of Grande Panda body shells in September 2025.
Renault Group's current official Envigado plant page identifies the Colombia site as a bodywork-assembly plant and reports 2025 production of Logan, Sandero, Duster and Kwid.

CMPC's current cellulose business page lists Santa Fe in Biobío, Chile as one of its pulp plants; its current renewable-fiber page states that bleached eucalyptus kraft pulp (BEKP) is produced at Santa Fe.
CMPC's current renewable and biodegradable fiber page explicitly states that BEKP is produced in Santa Fe.
A January 8 2026 FSC certificate published by CMPC identifies Planta Santa Fe (PSF) CMPC Pulp at Av. Julio Hemmelmann 670, Nacimiento, Chile, within CMPC Pulp SpA's certified network.

name: Planta de Amoniaco y Urea (Bulo Bulo)

sources.evidence: YPFB's current official plant page locates the Ammonia and Urea Plant at Bulo Bulo, Cochabamba and states nominal capacity of 1,200 tonnes/day ammonia and 2,100 tonnes/day urea using natural gas feedstock.
YPFB's March 10 2026 official release states that the Bulo Bulo Ammonia and Urea Plant restarted operations after maintenance and was ramping toward 90% capacity.

Holcim Ecuador's current official plants page identifies Planta Guayaquil GYE as a cement plant at km 18.5 Vía a la Costa, Guayaquil; the same page states that Holcim Ecuador operates an integrated cement plant in Guayaquil.

Holcim Ecuador's current official company page states that the company has more than 100 years in Ecuador producing cement, concrete and aggregates and operates an integrated cement plant in Guayaquil.
